ai_summary: Here is the executive summary:  Accel India IV (Mauritius) Limited divested 2.7 million shares, representing 1.48% of Blackbuck Limited, via an open market sale on September 11, 2026. This transaction reduced Accel's stake in Blackbuck from 7.17% to 5.69%, significantly decreasing its exposure to the company. While the sale isn't a severe red flag, a notable reduction in holding by an institutional investor could signal a shift in strategic outlook or portfolio rebalancing, potentially impacting market perception of Blackbuck.
